title: Discussion on CVE-2023-34362 vulnerability vector and campaign activity
content: Threat intelligence advisory regarding vulnerability CVE-2023-34362 associated with group TA505. Observed infrastructure uses C2 address 194.165.16.44 communicating over secure ports. Payload artifact identified with hash sha256 d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e99887766554433221100aabbccddeeff. Affected systems include enterprise file transfer platforms.

author: telemetry_lead
title: Identity verification bypass using CVE-2024-1709 telemetry
content: Analysis of campaign attributed to threat group Scattered Spider exploiting CVE-2024-1709 in remote management portals. Identified suspicious network listener active at IP 185.220.101.5 and domain sso-portal-verify.internal-auth.net. Binary sample associated with md5 hash 5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592.
